text: Refti yuusufa torii Joomi makko, o maaki: Joomi am, gomɗii A yeɗii lam laamagol Misra, A anndinii lam kadi firo koyɗi. An Tagirɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin e noone mo aldah e yeru gadano, Ko An woni giɗo heftuɗo denndaangal fiyakuuji am ɗin aduna e laakara. Ƴettitam tuma lajal am timmata ko mi juulɗo, waɗtidaa lam e Annabaaɓe moƴƴuɓe ɓen, immorde e baabiraaɓe am ɓen e woɗɓe goo, ka Aljanna firdawsi toowuɗo.
